skills.name: Hospice Care Information
skills.description: Answers general questions about hospice care, what to expect, and eligibility criteria.

skills.name: Make a Referral
skills.description: Guides healthcare professionals through referring a patient to Eternal Life Hospice.

skills.name: Medicare & Insurance Coverage
skills.description: Explains what Medicare Part A covers for hospice, how to verify benefits, and what families pay.

skills.name: Service Area Coverage Lookup
skills.description: Check whether Eternal Life Hospice serves a specific city in Ventura or Los Angeles County. Returns a structured yes/no answer with county, subregion, and a link to the city-specific hospice care page.

city.description: City name (case-insensitive; diacritics optional). Example: Pasadena
